sourceText:
Golden Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 11:08pm

Ingredients




20 ounces Can crushed pineapple
2 pkt (3 oz) unflavored gelatin
1 cup Unsweetened orange juice
1 cup Water
6 pkt Sugar substitute
2 Oranges, cut up
2 Apples, chopped
1 Banana, sliced
1 cup Fresh strawberries

Preparation

1 Drain crushed pineapple to obtain 1 cup juice. Add water to make 1 cup if needed. 2 Bring pineapple juice to a boil. Remove from heat and dissolve gelatin in juice. Add orange juice, water and sugar substitute. Cool. 3 Combine pineapple, oranges, apples, banana and strawberries. Pour gelatin mixture over fruit. Spoon into lightly greased 6-cup mold or large glass bowl. 4 Refrigerate until set.
